newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-14 PLAYERS DRAW FINES FOR COWBOYS-PACKERS SCUFFLE.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-14 PLAYERS DRAW FINES FOR COWBOYS-PACKERS SCUFFLE.

text.p: The National Football League fined 14 members of the Dallas Cowboys and Green Bay Packers a total of $64,000 for their part in a scuffle during Monday's game at Texas Stadium.

Eight players received the stiffest fines of $5,000 -- Charlie Williams, Alundis Bruce and Kavika Pittman of Dallas and Brian Williams, Roderick Mullen, William Henderson, Mike Robinson and Terry Mickens of Green Bay.
Six other players were fined $4,000 apiece.

The skirmish began after Chris Boniol of Dallas was sent out to kick an NFL record-tying seventh field goal in the final minute with a Dallas win a foregone conclusion. Boniol made the field goal to cap a 21-6 Cowboys victory.
